name: Coordinator thread
responsibility: Each tab session's separate fast thread that voice attaches to, the voice model's subconscious: its model, its settings, and how it is started
description: Started with its tab session's first message or Talk, before the workhorse, on gpt-6-sol at low effort with project_doc_max_bytes 0 and the workhorse and voice tool namespaces the host names (archboard_workhorse and archboard_voice in Archboard). It works in a directory of its own under the server's state directory, which is no checkout, so a command it runs finds no checkout's files; in Archboard a command without -C is refused. It gives work in a checkout to that checkout's workhorse. Each tab session has its own, so two tabs can talk at the same time, and it speaks for every workhorse of its tab. If it cannot start, the message or Talk is refused with the reason and no workhorse starts. It carries at most one voice session: a voice start that finds it already carried one starts a fresh thread first, and swaps it in only once it is ready, so the old thread is never driven again. Once the old thread's voice session has closed and no turn runs on it, the coordinator unsubscribes from it, so Codex unloads it. When the tab session ends, its threads are unsubscribed the same way. It runs turns only for a live voice session: a handoff, workhorse news, a spoken approval.
